title: Three Alpine Huts You Can Reach Before Lunch
description: Short, well-marked routes in the Berchtesgaden Alps for hikers who would rather spend the afternoon on a terrace than a summit.
headline_medium: Three Alpine Huts You Can Reach Before Lunch
body_medium: Not every mountain day needs an alpine start. These three huts sit between ninety minutes and two hours from the nearest car park, all on marked paths that stay walkable in trail shoes. The Gotzenalm serves its Kaiserschmarrn until four in the afternoon, and the terrace faces east, so it holds the morning sun. Bring cash: two of the three still do not take cards.

title: Lisbon on a Tuesday: What Is Actually Open
description: Half of Lisbon's museums close on Mondays and most guides bury it in a footnote. A midweek plan that avoids both the queues and the closures.
headline_medium: Lisbon on a Tuesday: What Is Actually Open
body_medium: Monday closures catch out more visitors to Lisbon than pickpockets do. The Gulbenkian, the Berardo and the Fado Museum all shut, and the tram queues absorb everyone who had planned otherwise. Tuesday is the quiet day: identical opening hours, about a third of the crowd. Start at the Gulbenkian before eleven, walk down through Campo Pequeno, and you will reach Alfama in time for a late lunch.
